description:
BI / ETL Developer role (SSIS) – must be highly technical  with SSIS and optimization. 
 
 Duties: 
 • Design, develop, configure and document business intelligence systems and data warehouse. 
 • Design and develop SSIS packages, stored procedures and ETL code 
 • Develop database objects, stored procedures and packages, views, tables and triggers as needed 
 • Converting data and tuning / optimizing code 
 • Upgrade databases from SQL Server 2000 / 2008 to SQL Server 2012HA 
 • Migrate DTS packages to SSIS 
 
 Requirements: 
 • Minimum 5 years BI / ETL solution development and Data Warehousing experience 
 • Hands-on experience in technical ETL Development with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) 
 • Technical experience with SQL Server 2005/2008 (SQL Server 2012 HA a plus) 
 • Experience developing stored procedures with T-SQL 
 • Expertise in query tuning, index creation, database optimization and troubleshooting 
 • Experience in gathering and analyzing business requirements 
 • Ability and experience producing technical documentation 
 • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and in team environment 


 
  
 3 month contract to hire
 Citizen or Green Card
